PluginData.Tooltip: V1.4h: live ship anchors and faster marker redraws.
PluginData.Description: V1.4h live marker lock test. Existing locally available ships use current positions at every marker projection. Fast camera updates also wake the overlay on fresh packets. Sensor-only tracks retain the prediction option. Disable the old local ZeoCore entry, refresh sources and fully restart. Settings are preserved. Windows/Pulsar Legacy only.
